summary: Colquitt County, GA tower on the Georgia tower list with a listed elevation of 301 (no unit given); a ca. 1955 Georgia Archives photo of the Colquitt Forestry Unit behind Sunset School notes a fire tower in the background. No build date or status found.

events.note: Ca. 1955 Georgia Archives photo notes a fire tower in the background of the Colquitt Forestry Unit behind Sunset School; the photo does not name the tower and its pin is about 10 km from the listed point

notes_for_editor: The coordinates disagree: the list gives 31.10399, -83.79805, while the Georgia Archives photo pin gives 31.18839, -83.76885, about 9.8 km apart. The photo is the only image evidence and does not name the tower. The list's sunset note may refer to Sunset School, but no source links the two. Two WebSearch queries and the cached pages found nothing on build date, staffing, fires or status. The list gives no units; feet are assumed, matching the brief's metres. The brief's lowercase name is the proposed correction.
